observations: The selected JPEG64 and zstd64 SIMD panels contain no bare C5/C4/62 encodings. Their timing changes cannot be attributed to executing the new packed reader.

SSL64 selected SIMD extents contain 51.584% bare 62, 7.587% C4, 5.753% C5; C5 optimization covers only a small fraction. Counts are linear benchmark instruction counts, not application dynamic frequencies.
AVX32 raw is now 2.64–3.20x faster than the baseline on this selected SIMD subset, but 0.821–1.011x iced; the source remains held for other-path regressions.
